text:
raj: FYI — Customer Gamma wants BYOK with an on-prem HSM but also requires a local subprocessor in SG to perform emergency key rewraps. Asking what our custody boundary looks like and what RBAC we need.
haley: hmm, jurisdictional crossover + subprocessor access is always messy. Do they want direct HSM access or a rewrap API?
morgan: they asked for "local operator rewraps" — basically customer-managed key but subprocessors can unwrap/rewrap under strict controls. That implies we need additional audit hooks + limited operator role.
raj: exactly. My initial thought: do NOT give raw HSM keys to subprocessor. Instead allow a proxy rewrap service that accepts a rewrap request and performs the unwrap in an ephemeral boundary with attestation. That keeps key material in the customer's HSM most of the time.
haley: agreed. From compliance side we need: 1) signed attestation for the rewrap operation, 2) per-operation audit record with requestor identity, 3) automated retention export for their auditors. Can we surface that in our audit logs?
morgan: we can. Need to add RBAC role "subprocessor_rewrap" with scoped permissions: can submit rewrap jobs, view rewrap audit records, cannot list/import/export CMKs. Also require MFA + justification tag on each action.
secbot: policy draft attached (snippet):
```
- role: subprocessor_rewrap
  actions: ["rewrap:submit","rewrap:status","audit:read:rewrap"]
  constraints:
    - mfa_required: true
    - reason_required: true
```
raj: nice. For KMS integration — does the proxy rewrap call into customer KMS or our HSM? For BYOK the customer HSM holds the CMK; so the proxy needs to establish a short-lived wrapping key inside the customer HSM or use an HSM-to-HSM escrow pattern.
morgan: two safe patterns: 1) ephemeral wrapping session inside customer HSM (preferred) 2) escrow proxy where a held-wrapped key is transferred under multi-party authorization. Ephemeral avoids persistent custody.
haley: log retention question: legal wants 7 years for some customers. Our default is 1 year — are we OK storing per-customer longer retention for audit records? Need opt-in and clear retention labels.
raj: we can add per-customer retention policy on the rewrap audit table and route to long-term archival. But need to watch PII in logs. Make sure logs are minimal: request id, operator id, attestation blob, input/output hashes (no key material).
oncall-sre: oncall implications — if a rewrap fails during DR, who is the primary contact? We should define escalation: subprocessor contacts local operator -> our oncall if proxy fails -> sec oncall if suspect. Add an automated incident tag when rewrap job fails checksum verification.
morgan: good call. Add a triage checklist to the runbook: verify attestation, inspect audit chain, do replay of rewrap in staging HSM with same firmware, escalate if mismatch.
haley: vuln triage: what if the proxy has a vulnerability allowing replay of rewrap requests? Controls: nonce per request, signed client certs, per-request TTL, and HSM side verification of request freshness. Add detection rules for duplicate nonces.
raj: add defense-in-depth: signed attestation from HSM firmware for each rewrap + counter for rewrap operation id. If counters jump we open an incident.
secbot: added detection rule to SIEM: "rewrap_nonce_replay" -> alert severity high -> create incident channel with prefixed thread.
raj: one more question — do we need customer consent for their subprocessor model? Legal says yes for cross-border subprocessors. We need export control checkbox + SOW appendix. haley can you coordinate?
haley: will do. I'll draft the SOW appendix and the language for customer consent. Also will update the compliance matrix and retention fields.
morgan: I'll create the RBAC change PR (iam/policies) and the runtimes PR for proxy rewrap paths. ETA EOD tomorrow.
oncall-sre: I'll add the oncall steps and runbook section with playbook snippets and create a short drill for tomorrow's oncall rotation.
raj: thanks all. If we can get the RBAC PR + policy snippet merged, we can demo the rewrap flow to the customer next week. :thumbsup:
haley: tagging legal and sales after this thread. Also cc @sec-review for final check.
secbot: reminder: attach hardware attestation logs to every rewrap ticket (rule enforced). :lock:
